format.stars: as ticket A's starts.json: a start is a list of knots, each the list of its places as numeric labels; knots are numbered in list order; distinctions are named by label in increasing order (FD 2.1); e is the label 1000
format.parts: each kind's knots: its first dead knot (knot 0, holding e), its members, then any further dead knots (pairs-3, pairs-4); labels from 0 (X's part) and from 100 (Y's part); 'first member' and 'other member' are member positions (0 = first)
format.starts: key 'X kind + Y kind / way': the start, X (X's members) and Y (Y's members) as knot numbers; s = 0; ways W1 to W4 (DB 2.3) join the first member; 'W1-other' to 'W3-other' (the other-member swap) join the other member of two-23, pairs-3 or pairs-4 where the way uses that pattern's member
format.alone: X alone (labels from 0) and Y alone (labels from 100): the part with e barred
format.per-law class: for each base law, the forms fixed after the scratch lists were seen (DB 5): members' h, maximal met sets as member positions, the part built by DB 5.1's rule (labels from 100), its first member (position 0 among its members, knot 1 of the part) and its first dead knot (knot 0 of the part, the one holding e)
format.renaming starts: the 18 starts of run B4 (keys of starts of DB 2 as in 'starts'), each with its ten renamed starts written out in full: names reversed; three seeded permutations of the labels; three of the order of the knots; one of both (with the generator call used, 'seed name' being the string the prototype used); two usable loose distinctions of one member exchanged; the order of the knots reversed
